title: Variables & Data Types
definition: JS has primitives (String, Number, Boolean, Null, Undefined, Symbol, BigInt) and Objects. Primitives are passed by value (stack), while Objects are passed by reference (heap).
simpleExplanation: Numbers are boxes you can copy easily. Objects are houses; if you copy the address and someone paints the house red, both you and your friend see a red house.

answers.question: **Basic:** Write a function to implement the core logic of Variables.
**Intermediate 1:** Optimize Variables to handle edge cases like empty arrays or negative numbers.
**Intermediate 2:** Solve a standard interview variation of Variables (e.g. LeetCode Medium).
**Advanced:** Scale Variables for massive datasets or implement it recursively.
**Expert/FAANG:** Solve Variables in O(1) space or O(N) time when constraints are extremely tight.
